item.title: The end of solar panels era — "Kirigami" photovoltaic cells track the Sun and produce up to 40% more energy
item.description: "Kirigami" photovoltaic cells have entered the picture, starting the end of the solar panel era. Fear not, however, as these photovoltaic cells track the sun.

item.title: Hydrogen era, new chapter — Kawasaki Heavy Industries unveils a 50,000-m³ vessel and hits a global transport milestone
item.description: A new chapter is beginning in Japan. Kawasaki Heavy Industries has unveiled a 50,000-m³ vessel to mark the beginning of this new phase of hydrogen production.

item.title: Poland’s Baltica 9 offshore wind farm secures price support in the country’s first contracts-for-difference auction
item.description: Poland recently concluded its first contract for difference auction, and the results have seen the Baltica 9 offshore wind farm securing price support.

item.title: Vietnam targets January 2026 agreement with Russia to revive nuclear power plans after Japan exit
item.description: The government of Vietnam has been working diligently to advance its nuclear energy market through two new projects that it aims to develop in 5 years.

item.title: Egypt opens global licensing round for offshore oil and gas acreage in the Red Sea
item.description: The future of the African energy market has been boosted by news that Egypt has opened international licensing for Red Sea offshore oil and gas acreage.

item.title: Louisiana Gateway Pipeline nears completion, adding new natural gas capacity along the U.S. Gulf Coast
item.description: The Louisiana Gateway Pipeline is just the latest in a long line of gas pipelines that are set to boost the US gas production sector to reach for the stars.

item.title: Shell moves forward with Refhyne II, planning a 100 MW hydrogen electrolyzer at its Rheinland site
item.description: Royal Dutch Shell is moving forward with its Refhyne II project. Shell has been working diligently to integrate renewable energy into its downstream sector.

item.title: It's 1,000x more powerful than any solar panel — Japanese students develop first titanium-selenium cell smashing records
item.description: Japanese students have developed the first titanium-selenium cell. They concluded that their technology is 1,000 times more powerful than any solar panel.

item.title: Beyond turbines — China flies giant wind kites at 16,000 feet to power 10,000 homes
item.description: China is reaching new heights in sustainability by seeking power beyond wind turbines and investing in giant wind kites instead, which are flown at 16,000 feet.

item.title: Sampension acquires 50% interest in near-completion onshore wind project in Greece
item.description: Sampension has acquired a 50% interest in the nearly complete Tsoukes Sarres wind project in Greece. The expansion of the renewable energy market is on track.
